## Data Source & Pre-processing

Card statistics and banlist metadata are sourced from the [YGOPRODeck API](https://ygoprodeck.com/api-guide/). The endpoint provides open community access to official Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card parameters.

To ensure self-contained, offline reproducibility without triggering live API rate limits or bloating git storage, the raw JSON payload was prepared beforehand into `data/ygo_staples_data.csv`:

* **Field Pruning:** Long card descriptions, flavor text, and media links were stripped to bring the serialized data down to under 2 MB.
* **Unnesting Metadata:** Community interaction stats (`views`, `upvotes`, `downvotes`) nested inside `misc_info` were extracted into flat numeric variables.
* **Banlist Standardization:** Official tournament restrictions (`banlist_info.ban_tcg`) were preserved to evaluate power creep and card legality.
